notes.title: Update 1.2 - Fighting monsters, new character, animations
notes.content:
Hi Evolvions![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623081/a3e482f36eae18c403f612cb78c32e8ebb82bc92.png"]



Update 1.2 is here and that means that we can finally fight some monsters. They are pretty peacefull for now but already look pretty evil. They are animated, and their terrifying breathing can be heard from far away. Bigger spiders breathe slower and louder.



In order to deal with them we have a choice of two malee weapons. Attack animations are added.

Speaking of animations, character can even perform a funny little dance. Oh any yes, there is a new character in the game (girl).



Killing mechanics is also supported by server-wide kill count and new type of community quests.

And with this, all major game mechanics are here and we can move toward shaping the gameplay.



Br,

WishFish

notes.title: Game Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623081/33d3f1c9bfd023c13b1a57b7f645d21ed339c3b9.png"]

📢 Game Update: Clearer Vision, Stronger Connection!

Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a new update focused on making the game’s core concept more transparent and improving the ways you can get involved in shaping its future. Here's what’s new:

🧠 Info Panel Added
You’ll now find an in-game Info Panel that clearly explains the game’s core idea, giving a better understanding of the world we’re building together.

🗣️ New NPC – The Guide
A new NPC has arrived who talks about the game’s vision and goals. Find him in-game for a quick overview and some insight into what the world is all about.

📜 Game Info Link in Menu
We’ve added a Game Info section to the main menu, where you can read more about the concept and philosophy behind the game. From there, you’ll also find a link to our Discord server – where your feedback and ideas are actively wanted and appreciated!

🏪 In-Game Kiosk to Discord
You’ll now see an in-game Suggestion Kiosk. Interacting with it opens the door (literally!) to the official Discord channel dedicated to player suggestions and development discussions.

We're committed to building this game with you, not just for you. Jump in, check out the updates, and let us know what you’d love to see next!

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/8a-L0TMnnXw"][/dynamiclink]

See you in-game,
– WishFish

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623081/0d644d2740b1ddcc3d07acfc0f904a4862dba274.pngWe’re Live – The World Is Yours!

The wait is over—the game is officially released! 🥳

After months of development, testing, tweaking, and anticipation, the persistent multiplayer sandbox is now live and ready for you to jump in. Whether you’ve been following us from the start or just found us today—welcome to the beginning of something special.

What Awaits You at Launch:

✅ Persistent multiplayer world
✅ Diverse building blocks
✅ Resource gathering
✅ Questing system
✅ A living, evolving world shaped by you

From this moment on, you’re not just playing the game—you’re helping shape it. Whether you're building monumental structures, digging into the terrain, or chasing down quests, this world is now your canvas.

A Living Project

This is just the start. Your feedback, creativity, and ideas will directly impact where the game goes from here. Regular updates, content expansions, and new features will be guided by you, the community.

We can't wait to see what you create, discover, and build.

💬 Share your thoughts, screenshots, and suggestions in the community hub.
📢 Keep an eye out for patch notes and dev logs coming soon!

Let’s build something incredible together.

— WishFish

notes.title: The wait is almost over
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623081/bdaf3e7c6cc00adfbdd95a8f9a1c901479a8f06f.png
Countdown Begins – Game Launches in Less Than a Week!

The wait is almost over!

In just a few short days, the game you've been waiting for will finally be live. All the core mechanics are in place and ready for you to explore, build and create.

This is more than a game—it’s a sandbox for your imagination. Whether you’re planning vast structures, shaping the terrain, or experimenting with different playstyles, the foundation is ready. Now it's your turn to take over and turn ideas into reality.

What’s Ready at Launch:

    ✔️ Persistent multiplayer world

    ✔️ Building blocks of different type

    ✔️ Gathering resources

    ✔️ Questing


This is just the beginning. The world is alive, and from the moment you enter, you’re part of its development.

Shaping the Future Together

This game is launching as a living project. Your feedback and creativity will guide future updates. We’re building this world with you.

Stay tuned for more details, patch notes, and dev updates as we get closer to launch day.

Mark your calendars—release is coming in under a week.

Let’s build something incredible together.

— WishFish
